basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast who recently got into the world of Apple products. Currently living in Lynn, MA, I enjoy spending my weekends fishing and tinkering with racing simulators like NR2003. I work as a junior software developer, a role that feeds my curiosity and passion for learning new technologies. I'm currently single and usually online during the evenings after work. I dislike the high cost of cloud services and am always on the lookout for free or more affordable alternatives.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having graduated from a local community college. Most of my knowledge about tech comes from personal interest and online courses. I'm still learning the ropes when it comes to Apple products, as I've been a long-time Windows and Android user.
